name: The Masque of Slaanesh

bonuses.name: Allure of Slaanesh
bonuses.text: Attack Tests made against the Masque use Willpower as their Attribute - ranged attacks use Ballistic Skill (Wil), melee attacks use Weapon Skill (Wil).

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 3 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Herald of Slaanesh
bonuses.text: If any Daemonette is within Short Range of this Threat, they may re-roll any 1s on their attack rolls.

abilities.name: Disquieting Creature & Quicksilver Swiftness
abilities.text: Anyone that can see or hear the Masque must pass a DN 3 Fear Test. The Masque then acts first in the Initiative order as though they had Seized the Initiative.

abilities.name: The Eternal Dance
abilities.text: On this Threat's turn, it may spend 1 Ruin to target all Agents or 1 Agent-allied Mob with one of the following effects. The target must be within Medium range. The effect lasts until the Threat's next turn. - Target of Ridicule: Daemons of Slaanesh gain +2 bonus attack dice against the target. - Stage Fright: Target takes a -2 dice penalty to attack rolls. - Lack of Commitment: Target's attacks lose their ED Trait.

abilities.name: Exquisite Agonies
abilities.text: When this Threat rolls a Wrath Critical, its attacks gain the Agonising Trait.

note: Name printed 'The Masque of Slaanesh' on the stat block header ('MASQUE OF SLAANESH' on the block, 'The Masque of Slaanesh' as the entry heading).
determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 6d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
